decisions.reason: Assigning the People category to the Nolan Pierce article does not change the existing requirements for author name, matching author photo, source, or placement.
The article category mapping does not change the required size or circular shape of author photos.
The source concerns the category of the Nolan Pierce article and does not affect the color restriction for the Dorian Vale article.
Specifying the Nolan Pierce article's category does not change the Civic Lantern website as the source of article content.
The category assignment adds article metadata but does not modify the magazine's polished, modern, brand-aligned visual style.
The Nolan Pierce category mapping does not alter the required digital flipbook PDF deliverable.
The category mapping has no effect on the requirement to enhance image quality when necessary.
The article category assignment does not change the deferred print-ready output, its resolution, or its prepress settings.
